title: Labels in a part
statement: Let $n,q,k$ be natural numbers, let each vertex in a collection of $q$ parts of size $k$ have a label in an $n$-element set, and fix one part. The set of labels in that part is the set of labels attained by its $k$ positions.
hypotheses_covered: There are $q$ parts, each with $k$ positions
Each position is labeled by an element of an $n$-element set
